586db5.title: Tirtonic target map baseline
586db5.content:
Repository `/workspace/Tirtonic` is a Next.js 14 + Prisma + Supabase application with these primary runtime surfaces derived from source:

- Public commerce site in `src/app/(site)/**` including cart, checkout, order page, articles, sponsorship, shop, product, string-finder.
- Privileged dashboard in `src/app/dashboard/**`.
- Stringer/kiosk flow in `src/app/stringer/**` and `src/app/api/sf/**`.
- Community/event flows in `src/app/komunitas/**`, `src/app/event/**`, `src/app/leaderboard`, `src/app/riwayat/**`.
- API routes in `src/app/api/**` including DOKU notify, QR/token routes, invite, product-view, slip.

Auth/integration notes from source:
- Admin auth: HMAC-signed role cookie in `src/lib/auth.ts`.
- Stringer auth: separate HMAC cookie in `src/lib/stringer-auth.ts`.
- Community auth: HMAC-signed community id + DB lookup in `src/lib/community-auth.ts`.
- Storage: Supabase service-role upload helpers in `src/lib/storage.ts`.
- Payments: DOKU checkout + webhook verification in `src/lib/doku.ts`.

Threat model saved for `/workspace/Tirtonic`; subagents should call `get_threat_model` first and amend if they disprove any assumption.
